**Naming: the multi-target install/distribution explore is Track F (Distribution), NOT Track D — Track D is governance hardening (D1/D2/D3)**

**What**: The third measurement thread (the multi-target INSTALL/DISTRIBUTION explore that runs between D2 checkpoints) is named **Track F: Distribution**, NOT "Track D". Correcting an earlier loose reference.

**Why**: Collision. In `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md`, **Track D = governance hardening** (D1 memory-gate v2, D2 rung-3 auto-revert guardrails, D3 configurable budget). D2 — the slice Claude Code is about to run — belongs to that Track D. Calling the install-distribution explore "Track D" too would collide. The PLAN's **Track F = Adoption friction & agent context** (F1 `brain:adopt --apply`, F2 AGENTS.md) — the distribution/adoption theme. So the multi-target install explore is Track F: Distribution.

**How to apply**: When referring to the parallel-team measurement thread (multi-target install), always say "Track F: Distribution". Reserve "Track D" for governance hardening (D1/D2/D3). This explore is READ/measurement — it does not compete for the construction budget.

**Where**: `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md` (Track D §5 governance hardening; Track F §7 adoption). Related: [[architecture/worktree-workspace-model]].
